verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੀਆ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਦੁਬਾਜਰਾ ਸਪੁ ਦੁਮੂਹਾ ਬੁਰਾ ਬੁਰਿਆਈ।
verses.translit_en: dhukheeaa dhusaT dhubaajaraa sap dhumoohaa buraa buriaaiee|

en.bdb: The wicked and unhappy is the betrayer who is like two headed snake which is also undesirable.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭਦੂੰ ਮੰਦੀ ਸਪ ਜੋਨਿ ਸਪਾਂ ਵਿਚਿ ਕੁਜਾਤਿ ਕੁਭਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: sabhadhoo(n) ma(n)dhee sap jon sapaa(n) vich kujaat kubhaiee|

en.bdb: Snake's is the worst species and out of that also the two-headed snake is a bad and wicked variety.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੋੜੀ ਹੋਆ ਗੋਪਿ ਗੁਰ ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਤੰਤੁ ਨ ਮੰਤੁ ਸੁਖਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: koRee hoaa gop gur nigure ta(n)t na ma(n)t sukhaiee|

en.bdb: Its master remains unknown and on this unprincipled creature no mantra works.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੋੜੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਲੜੈ ਜਿਸ ਵਿਗੜ ਰੂਪਿ ਹੋਇ ਮਰਿ ਸਹਮਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: koRee hovai laRai jis vigaR roop hoi mar sahamaiee|

en.bdb: Any one whom it bites becomes leper. His face is deformed and he dies of its fear.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਲਾਤੋ ਲਾਵਾ ਲਾਇ ਬੁਝਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh manmukh baaharaa laato laavaa lai bujhaiee|

en.bdb: Manmukh, the mind-oriented one does not accept the advice of gurmukhs and creates quarrel here and there.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਹੁ ਵਾਤਿ ਕੁਲਾਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਗਣਤੀ ਤਾਤਿ ਪਰਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: tis vih vaat kulaat man a(n)dhar ganatee taat paraiee|

en.bdb: His speech is poisonous and in his mind are cherished sordid plans and jealousies.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰ ਚਿਥੈ ਵਿਹੁ ਬਾਣਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੮॥
verses.translit_en: sir chithai vih baan na jaiee ||8||

en.bdb: His poisonous habit does not go even when his head is crushed.
